newsitem.title: USA: Merrimac's CEO replaces chairman Huber II.
newsitem.headline: Merrimac's CEO replaces chairman Huber II.

text.p: WEST CALDWELL, N.J., July 25 (Reuter) Merrimac Industries Inc said Friday its board named chief executive Mason Carter chairman of the company, as current chairman Charles Huber II resigned.
Huber, 67, said in a statement that it was "time to transfer my responsibilities, having the greatest of confidence in the future of Merrimac and Mason Carter."
Carter, who is both chief executive and president of Merrimac, was not immediately available for comment.
